Subject: SOC 2 MAP: Stakeholder onboarding & evidence milestones

Hi Bethany / Acme security team —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the MAP for the SOC 2 evaluation. I wanted to put a quick note that lays out the initial plan, owners we think should be assigned on both sides, and the immediate asks so we can hit the proposed close window in early April. Attached is a starter MAP workbook (acme_map_v1.xlsx) and our evidence roster template.

High-level proposal:
- Goal: complete SOC 2 readiness evidence intake + evaluation by week of Apr 6, 2026.
- Milestones: evidence intake (by Feb 26) -> initial controls review (Mar 12) -> remediation & retest (Mar 26) -> final verification (Apr 2)
- Redwood lead for GRC coordination: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) — will own evidence collection and questions.
- Redwood sales & program lead: me (Dylan Brooks) and Vivek Kulkarni will coordinate timelines and any procurement asks.
- CS owner: Marissa Cole will manage ongoing access requests and run-of-show for eval tests.

Immediate asks for Acme:
1) Confirm internal evidence owner(s) for the items in tab "Evidence Roster" — if you prefer, we can map individual artifacts to your existing teams (security, infra, legal).
2) Share S3/Drive links or upload evidence directly to the Drive folder in the MAP doc (link below).
3) Quick intro call: propose Tue Feb 17 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed Feb 18 09:00–09:30 PT. Please confirm one slot.

Attachments: acme_map_v1.xlsx (starter MAP), evidence_roster_template.csv (headers + examples)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_MAP_Acme_v1
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-MAP-47

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0132

Thanks for the ping — I'm Laura, GRC Manager at Redwood and I'll be the primary evidence reviewer for this engagement. A few operational notes from my side before the call: 

- Evidence mapping: please ask Acme to fill the "provided?" column in the attached evidence_roster_template.csv. That helps us triage outstanding items quickly.
- Sensitive data handling: if any artifact contains PHI or patient-identifiable info, please flag it and we will arrange an encrypted transfer (do not attach PHI in Drive).
- SCIM / provisioning artifacts: for any screenshots of SSO/SAML config, include config exports where possible (we can take config snippets).
- Timeline adjustments: based on our intake cadence, if evidence intake slips beyond Feb 26, we will need to compress the control review window — flag any blockers early.

Action items for Redwood before the call:
- I will prepare a short checklist (controls-to-evidence map) and bring examples to the call.
- Marissa will prepare access instructions for any test accounts we need.
